Remarks

These are the provider's answers, to be copied and not decided. A platform that gates a paid offer on PayoutsEnabled is reading what the provider will actually do, rather than its own guess at it.

public PayeeAccountDTO(string AccountId, bool ChargesEnabled, bool PayoutsEnabled, bool DetailsSubmitted, string? DisabledReason)

Parameters

AccountId string

The provider's identifier for the account.

ChargesEnabled bool

Whether the account may be charged.

PayoutsEnabled bool

Whether the provider will pay the account out. Until it is true, money sent there cannot leave.

DetailsSubmitted bool

Whether onboarding was completed, which is not the same as being enabled: the provider may still be checking what was submitted.

DisabledReason string

Why the provider is holding the account back, when it is.
